svg.aria-label: ESM-2 encoder stack of six layers. Embeddings and layers 0 to 3 are frozen, holding 4,942,521 parameters. Layers 4 and 5 plus the MLM head are trainable, holding 2,580,513 parameters or 34.3 percent of the model.
svg.text: What trains and what does not
ESM-2 t6 has six encoder layers. The embeddings and the bottom four are frozen; gradients reach only the top two layers and the MLM head.
Lines are the all-to-all attention paths between layers. The MLM decoder is untied from the frozen
embeddings so the head can train, which a tied decoder would prevent.
